_analysisNotes.layer: TSF4G/tdr 'PacketCode' serialization layer (src: d:\mhfc\oprelease\code\common\protocols\packetcode\TdrBuf.h and TdrBufUtil.cpp). This is the REAL MHO client<->server TCP packet body format, NOT stock CryEngine transport.
twoFamilies: PACK/serialize methods (TdrBuf.h): signature (this, TdrBuf* {base@0,pos@4,len@8}, version). Write struct fields sequentially into the send buffer. Helpers: FUN_1010c0c0=write u8, FUN_1010c120=write u16, FUN_1010c190=write i32, FUN_1010c200=write i64(lo,hi), FUN_1010bf70=reserve 4B length slot, FUN_1010c2b0=write raw bytes, FUN_1010c3c0=backpatch 4B LE length prefix (together = length-delimited string), FUN_101150a0/FUN_101159e0=bounded/enum-or-signed u8 writers. Fixed layout, NO per-field tag byte, NO presence flags. Server MUST reproduce this byte layout exactly.

DUMP/print methods (TdrBufUtil.cpp): signature (this, sink, indent, sepChar). Emit a human-readable text dump; helpers FUN_1024a290=print scalar(name,fmt,val), FUN_1024a410=print string field, FUN_1024a140/FUN_1024a1e0/FUN_1024a230=indent/sub-object headers, FUN_1010c010=sprintf-append. Client-side debug only; NOT wire-relevant, but the '[fieldName]' literals recover the in-memory struct field layout used by the pack methods.
_analysisNotes.docDiscrepancyGeneral: The generated TLV_DOCS (docs/*.md, c#_unsafetlvstructures/*.cs) describe a DIFFERENT serializer family: the 0x99 NoVariant TAG-based readers in CryGame.dll (addresses 0x1017xxxx-0x1024xxxx) with tag=(field_id<<4)|wire_type and presence-flag bitmasks. NONE of the functions in this chunk use a tag>>4 switch, 0x99, or presence flags. They are the packetcode fixed-layout counterpart. Where a struct name overlaps, field TYPES disagree (see GuideBook / CatCuisine notes). Treat the generated docs as describing the config/CryGame TLV path, and these functions as the actual network packet path.
_analysisNotes.duplicates: Many single-field packers are byte-identical duplicates (compiler-emitted per-struct): the 32-char-string packer (103daf70/103db2f0/103db960/103df550/103df8d0/103e1060) and the single-u8 packer (103d7470/103e86c0/103e89e0/103e9340/1040a360/10414170/1041c640/1041e120) recur.
_analysisNotes.msgIdNote: No RMI/dispatch/opcode table is present in this chunk, so msgId is unknown for every function. Direction is inferred only from field-name semantics (iErrCode/iRetCode/iResult -> S2C reply; stReq/stRequest -> C2S request); otherwise unknown.
